explication: This repository stages the native TypeScript compiler and its editor tooling. The main workflow runs the CLI or language server, creates and checks TypeScript programs, then emits output or serves editor requests. The README documents parsing, type checking, project builds, watch mode, and language-service support. The VS Code extension launches the server; the preview package exposes a native API client. Relationships reflect the supplied excerpts and SOURCE INDEX; unsampled implementation details are not asserted.
